items.title: El Niño brzo jača. Znanstvenici objavili kad se očekuje vrhunac
items.summary: WMO PROGNOZIRA da će El Niño ojačati i dosegnuti vrhunac u prosincu 2026., uzrokujući rekordne temperature mora i mijenjajući vremenske obrasce, što globalno povećava rizik od suša i poplava.

items.title: Study aims to reduce teacher burnout and turnover
items.summary: A new study examined how positive psychology interventions could help reduce teacher burnout and turnover, retain valuable knowledge and experience in our schools and create better learning environments for students.

items.title: High-resolution global atmospheric model erases 'popcornlike' rain
items.summary: Global climate and weather forecasting use predictive models that divide Earth's atmosphere into a grid, with each section typically covering tens to hundreds of kilometers. Now a new model, run by a team at the University of Tokyo, has narrowed this grid spacing to just 220 meters (720 feet).

items.summary: New fossils from South Africa are reshaping the story of early human evolution. items.title: Strong reading skills may help teens resist misinformation
items.summary: Students with stronger reading skills are better able to spot misinformation online—and those skills may be especially important for teenagers from disadvantaged backgrounds, according to a new study from the Brown School at Washington University in St. Louis.

items.title: NASA is searching for hidden caves to build its first Moon base
items.summary: NASA is preparing for humanity’s first Moon base with three investigations that will hunt for underground shelters, uncover hidden ice, and track dangerous conditions on the lunar surface. items.title: Poznata kanadska književnica Anne Carson osvojila Nobela za književnost
items.summary: KANADSKA spisateljica i klasična filologinja Anne Carson (76) dobitnica je Nobelove nagrade za književnost za 2026. godinu za svoj hrabar i inventivan opus koji spaja antičke i suvremene motive.

items.summary: Cholesterol, a fat-like substance in the body best known for its role in cardiovascular health, also plays a key role in how neurons—foundational cells for the brain's ability to process and integrate information—communicate with one another. items.title: Private equity investments rapidly reshaping CPA firms, creating a gap in accounting education, study finds
items.summary: The traditional CPA firm partnership model is undergoing its most rapid transformation in decades. Driven by private equity (PE) investments and acquisitions, public accounting firms are restructuring operations, compensation and career pathways.

items.title: Mission success: Australian cancer research returns from space
items.summary: Human stem cells from Adelaide University's Center for Cancer Biology have successfully traveled to the edge of space and back as part of a landmark mission for Australian cancer research.
